instruction: Create EventJoinIcon.tsx exporting EventJoinIcon and isSafeConferenceUrl. EventJoinIconProps has url (string), title (string optional), baseColor (string), and className (string optional). Export pure boolean function isSafeConferenceUrl(url: unknown): url is string validating non-empty string and protocol === 'http:' or 'https:'. EventJoinIcon renders an anchor <a> with href=url, target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer', aria-label (title ? `Join meeting: ${title}` : 'Join meeting'), and className cn('ph-no-capture absolute bottom-0.5 z-10 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xs p-0.5 hover:opacity-80 focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:outline-(--event-focus-color)', className ?? 'right-1'). Call e.stopPropagation() on onClick, onMouseDown, and onKeyDown for Enter/Space. Render VideoCameraIcon directly imported from '@phosphor-icons/react' with aria-hidden='true', color=darken(baseColor, 30), size=10, weight='bold'. Do not create or import any intermediate icon wrapper.
acceptance: EventJoinIcon.tsx exports EventJoinIcon and isSafeConferenceUrl
isSafeConferenceUrl returns true only for valid http: and https: string URLs
VideoCameraIcon is imported directly from '@phosphor-icons/react'
Anchor element has rel='noopener noreferrer', target='_blank', and class 'ph-no-capture'
onClick, onMouseDown, and onKeyDown (Enter/Space) call stopPropagation
VideoCameraIcon uses darken(baseColor, 30), size 10, and bold weight

instruction: Integrate EventJoinIcon into TimedEventCard.tsx. Import EventJoinIcon and isSafeConferenceUrl from './EventJoinIcon'. Compute showJoinIcon = isSafeConferenceUrl(event.conference?.url) && !isPlaceholder && durationMinutes >= REPEAT_ICON_MIN_DURATION_MINUTES && position.width >= REPEAT_ICON_MIN_WIDTH. When showJoinIcon is true, render EventJoinIcon with baseColor=bgColor, className=(showRepeatIcon ? 'right-4.5' : 'right-1'), title=event.title, and url=event.conference!.url before showRepeatIcon rendering. Preserve existing REPEAT_ICON_MIN_WIDTH = 40 and all other props, handlers, and styles.

inputs.reason: Component and helper imported by TimedEventCard

acceptance: TimedEventCard imports EventJoinIcon and isSafeConferenceUrl from ./EventJoinIcon
showJoinIcon is gated on isSafeConferenceUrl, !isPlaceholder, durationMinutes >= 15, and width >= 40
When showRepeatIcon is true, EventJoinIcon receives className='right-4.5'; otherwise 'right-1'
EventJoinIcon renders with event.conference.url, event.title, and baseColor=bgColor
No other existing behaviors, resize handles, or event handlers are modified

instruction: Integrate EventJoinIcon into AllDayEventCard.tsx. Import EventJoinIcon and isSafeConferenceUrl from './EventJoinIcon'. Compute showJoinIcon = isSafeConferenceUrl(event.conference?.url) && !isPlaceholder && position.width >= REPEAT_ICON_MIN_WIDTH (keeping REPEAT_ICON_MIN_WIDTH = 60). Update title container className to dynamically apply 'pr-7' when showRepeatIcon && showJoinIcon, or 'pr-3.5' when (showRepeatIcon && !showJoinIcon) || (!showRepeatIcon && showJoinIcon). Render EventJoinIcon with baseColor=bgColor, className=(showRepeatIcon ? 'right-4.5' : 'right-1'), title=event.title, and url=event.conference!.url when showJoinIcon is true. Preserve all other props and handlers.

inputs.reason: Component and helper imported by AllDayEventCard

acceptance: AllDayEventCard imports EventJoinIcon and isSafeConferenceUrl from ./EventJoinIcon
showJoinIcon is gated on isSafeConferenceUrl, !isPlaceholder, and width >= 60
Title container applies 'pr-7' for both icons, 'pr-3.5' for single icon, and no padding class for neither
EventJoinIcon receives className='right-4.5' when showRepeatIcon is true, else 'right-1'
EventJoinIcon renders with event.conference.url, event.title, and baseColor=bgColor

instruction: Extend EventCard.test.tsx to add unit tests covering AC-1 through AC-11 for EventJoinIcon in TimedEventCard and AllDayEventCard. Test cases must cover: (AC-1) render valid link with href and aria-label for timed and all-day cards; (AC-2) reject hostile URL schemes (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:) while rendering valid positive control; (AC-3) suppress icon when conference is undefined, null, or empty url; (AC-4) hide icon on timed card when duration < 15 min; (AC-5) hide icon on timed card when width < 40; (AC-6) verify coexistence of repeat icon ('right-1') and join icon ('right-4.5') on recurring timed events; (AC-7) verify title container padding permutations (none, pr-3.5, pr-7) on all-day cards; (AC-8) verify mouseDown and click on join link stop propagation and do not invoke card callbacks; (AC-9) verify Enter/Space keyDown on join link stops propagation; (AC-10) verify join link attributes target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer', and class 'ph-no-capture'; (AC-11) verify descriptive accessible label on join link. Use bun:test and @testing-library/react.
acceptance: AC-1: Valid conference URLs render join affordance link on TimedEventCard and AllDayEventCard
AC-2: Hostile schemes (javascript:, data:, vbscript:, file:) are rejected while positive control https: renders
AC-3: Null, undefined, or empty conference URLs do not render join affordance
AC-4: Timed card with duration under 15 minutes hides join affordance
AC-5: Timed card with width under 40px hides join affordance
AC-6: Recurring timed events with conference render both repeat icon (right-1) and join icon (right-4.5) without collision
AC-7: All-day cards apply dynamic title padding for all 4 permutations (none, repeat-only pr-3.5, join-only pr-3.5, both pr-7)
AC-8: MouseDown and click on join icon stop propagation and do not trigger card selection or scaler resize
AC-9: Enter and Space keyDown on join icon stop propagation and do not trigger card keyboard activation or parent listeners
AC-10: Join link has target='_blank', rel='noopener noreferrer', and class 'ph-no-capture'
AC-11: Join link has descriptive aria-label including event title
